cases.originalText: Favorable reputation alone does not authorize this cast without actual faction membership and invocation permission.
cases.currentAdjudication: Favorable reputation or affiliation alone does not authorize this cast. The caster must have actual recorded membership in one exact canonical faction AND actual invocation permission under the reviewed Faction Seal permission procedure. Qualifying Null damage at0 uses finite-summon Disabled, not immediate end.

Initial state: caster A has no Veil when A commits an eligible rank-3 damaging spell against protected B; B has Spell Shield and a Reaction. The source spell does not create its damage root until its ordinary damage-resolution checkpoint. B reflects before that checkpoint. Spell Shield creates no replacement root and does not move the checkpoint. A remains caster/dealer. A's Veil state is unchanged (none) through the real root checkpoint, so the root is ordinary lethal-capable damage; B's Veil state is irrelevant. Boundary variant: if an independently legal event gives A a Veil before the original root checkpoint, that newly created original root is `nullNonlethal=true`; if A gains the Veil only after the root checkpoint, the already-created root keeps its ordinary flag. If the source spell had created its root before reflection, its existing flag would simply be preserved.

Initial state: Wizard A is un-Veiled, RP20, concentrating on no spell. B is Veiled and has pending Spell Shield plus a Reaction. A casts operational Charm Person (rank1, base2 RP, concentration up to1 minute) at B from 20 ft. At cast commitment A pays 2 RP and establishes Charm Person concentration before the reaction window. B reflects. The return from B to A is legal and uses A's original spell DC and ownership. B's Veil creates no new Null root because Spell Shield is redirection, not new damage. A remains the concentration owner even though A is now the returned target; if A fails its WIS save the same Charm Person branch affects A under its own odd-but-legal self-target result until its normal ending. Reflection neither transfers concentration to B nor opens a second cast/price/Refrain event. Spell Shield's own deadline is the tenth future regular-start marker of its caster (or application+60s outside initiative), fixed through suppression/absence/death; Charm Person creates no damage root because it deals no damage.

Variant A, Lock first. Target T has underlying Chaotic Evil. L is a legal rank-4 Alignment Lock caster, pays 7 RP as an Action; T fails the CHA save. Lock snapshots Chaotic/Evil for +24 elapsed hours. P then legally casts rank-7 Alignment Purge, pays 17 RP as an Action; T fails WIS, and P concentrates for 60 elapsed seconds on a Neutral/Neutral overlay below Lock. Effective read remains Chaotic Evil while Lock is active. S is a Lawful Good Wizard with Alignment Suggestion prepared: Action, 30 ft, base 2 RP, WIS save, concentration up to one minute. T fails. Suggestion baseline excludes target-side Purge and prior Suggestion plus AC4 Lock/Anchor under AC4-ALIGN-01, so baseline is underlying Chaotic Evil; caster snapshot is Lawful Good; one-step values become Neutral/Neutral and remain live below Lock. Purge ending does not alter Lock. Suggestion ending does not alter Lock. At +24h Lock ends and the then-live lawful lower record becomes effective. Variant B, lower overlay first: T begins Chaotic Evil; S first applies Suggestion toward Lawful Good, producing Neutral/Neutral after failed WIS and paying 2 RP; L then applies Lock after failed CHA and snapshots the currently effective Neutral/Neutral. If Suggestion later ends, Lock remains Neutral/Neutral until its own +24h deadline. No undefined axis, refund, replay, or staircase is created.

Initial state: target T is under reviewed Purge, so effective alignment is Neutral/Neutral while underlying record is Chaotic Good. A Conjuration rank4 Alignment Anchor zone is created for 7 RP; T is inside at creation and its first zone snapshot is Neutral/Neutral. Purge later ends, but while T stays in the zone the Anchor still freezes Neutral/Neutral. T exits: the zone constraint becomes inactive and underlying Chaotic Good is effective. T reenters the same zone: it reuses that application's original Neutral/Neutral snapshot rather than taking a new snapshot. A separate later Alignment Lock can coexist by its own timestamp; earliest active eligible lock per axis governs among same-family locks. A creature whose moral axis is genuinely undefined entering the zone receives no fabricated Neutral value on that axis. All casts keep their real costs/deadlines regardless of hidden eligibility.

Initial state: caster C has actual invocation permission for canonical faction F and creates Protection-mode Faction Sanctuary, paying7 RP and concentrating up to10 minutes. Owner O is a genuine member of F. O's temporary Faction Envoy stands inside the sanctuary, but its summon record grants only temporary faction affiliation, not institutional membership. Result: O can receive the +2 AC benefit if O personally occupies the area; the Envoy receives no member-only benefit unless an independent actual membership record for that exact body exists. O's positive standing or membership cannot be borrowed by the Envoy. No membership fact is publicly disclosed by the failed benefit.

Initial state: Water Pet is at 6/35 HP with 24 seconds left on its caster's concentration. A Veiled dealer's qualifying root deals 8; Pet reaches0 and becomes the same Null Disabled0 body. A second qualifying Null hit for 5 while it is already Disabled0 does not end, replace, reapply or create a new recovery clock. On the Cleric's next turn, a Cleric 5 (Wisdom16, M=3, S=2) within30 ft spends an Action and 2 RP on actual Healing Rite, whose target is one living ally. Under NEW scoped AC4-SUMMON-TARGET-01 the Water Pet qualifies mechanically while its body exists; roll 2d8=9, +3 =12 HP, so Pet becomes 12/35 and Disabled ends. This classification claims no natural biology/soul/corpse rule. Independent-expiry control: if no heal occurs, the same Disabled body ends at its original +24s concentration deadline; no corpse, loot, water stock or refund appears.

Initial state: one multiclass owner controls a Water Pet and another companion; both are ready, owner has one Bonus Action and the ordinary one shared damaging/support activation for numbered round 5. Owner spends the Bonus Action commanding Water Pet to heal ally R; roll2d6=7 and R regains7 subject to normal cap. By the AC4 scoped rule that heal spends the owner's one shared support/offense activation for round5. The second companion cannot then make its damaging attack in round5 even if another effect could issue it a command; an extra turn does not refresh the numbered-round allowance. Conversely, if the second companion had attacked first, Water Pet could still move/Dodge under a legal command but could not use its heal that round.

Field is active. A casts an ordinary rank-4 7-RP spell: mandatory field extra +2 produces 9 before final Resonance Influence; with Ease -1 final price is 8. B is a Winterfang Druid 14 using the actual Master of Winter source permission to cast its bounded winter control-weather spell once without expending Resonance Points. That source waiver zeroes the ordinary RP payment, but the AC4 field mandatory extra is then +2; with no broader waiver B must pay 2 RP in addition to consuming the once/long-rest use, or cannot commit. C is a Wizard 2 using actual Ritual Casting: a ritual spell's source price is 0 RP unless it explicitly consumes RP; if a legal ritual's resolution/casting point occurs while this field applies, the field's mandatory +2 is still evaluated before final Influence, though the ritual's own 10-minute time and encounter prohibition remain real. D has no RP pool and therefore cannot commit a spell route whose final mandatory field price is positive. Ranger Druidic Arrow remains a magical class technique, not an ordinary spell, so the field adds no RP. Oracle Revelation Charges remain nonspell class power and are outside.

Exact comparison: owner O previously paid the legal Summon Spectral Steed cast and is maintaining its original one-minute concentration; the Large steed is carrying one willing Medium rider whose effective body+gear is 180 lb and 5 Load, within the 350-lb/12-Load caps. O begins its turn with the steed within60 ft and perceptive. O spends the required Bonus Action command for Planar Crossing toward a specific known site on another plane. The steed acts immediately after O and spends its Action; its one crossing attempt is consumed when the attempt starts. Unknown to O, a separately maintained Dimensional Anchor already covers the destination footprint. At resolution the endpoint is illegal, so steed+rider+permitted gear remain atomically at origin. The Action, command and one crossing attempt are not refunded; no hidden reason/coordinates are revealed; the steed's original concentration clock continues. No mid-resolution cast, free interrupt or cross-plane trigger perception is invented. Control: same-plane teleport endpoints both outside an Anchor are not blocked merely because an imaginary straight line crosses the sphere.

Barrier is a30x10 selective plane. A carrier physically carries a genuinely Corrupted passenger toward it. Because the passenger's occupied body would cross, the barrier stops the crossing at the boundary and triggers that passenger's first contact packet for the numbered round; CON save is rolled for that passenger. Later an unsupported Corrupted creature falls through the plane: barrier does not provide support, so it takes one eligible contact packet and the ordinary fall continues beyond the plane. A third Corrupted traveler teleports from one legal space to a fitting destination wholly beyond the barrier without destination overlap; there is no physical path test, so Corruption Barrier alone does not block that teleport. Each creature's one contact entitlement uses its own numbered-round/six-second interval; no standing-near tick is added.

Target E has an actual Elemental creature-type record and is perceived at40 ft. Caster C has already spent its shared character→E hard-denial allowance earlier this encounter. C casts Bind Element anyway, pays7 RP, E fails WIS. The new Paralyzed hard component is blocked by the already-spent guard; no Restrained/Stunned/soft fallback is invented and the paid cast is not refunded. Control variant: with an unused guard, failure establishes Paralyzed through E's second future regular end; at first future end E fails the repeat WIS save, then the effect is suppressed for one interval. Suppression does not pause or restart the second-turn marker. At the second scheduled regular end the application expires even if still suppressed; restoration afterward cannot reapply it for free.

Caster creates one Crystalline Barrier and pays7 RP; wall starts AC18/40HP with original one-minute concentration deadline. Object-legal attacks deal13 total damage, leaving27HP. The wall is then suppressed; a Medium creature moves into part of the former footprint. Suppression does not heal or reset HP. Before the footprint clears, the original concentration deadline arrives and the spell expires. Result: no wall resumes, no creature is evicted/crushed, no 27-HP renewed wall is banked, and no elemental-glass crafting stock or shards are created.

Recipient R has Greater Warding, an existing Warding Bond whose caster is B, R has 3 temp HP, B has 2 temp HP; both start at 20/20 HP. One spell-origin packet deals 11 to R. Greater Warding resistance applies once: floor(11/2)=5. Warding Bond is mandatory post-defense: transfer floor(5/2)=2 to B and leave 3 on R. The transferred 2 skips a second mitigation/prevention stage. Apply temp HP separately: R's 3 temp HP absorbs its retained 3, leaving R 20/20 HP and 0 temp HP; B's 2 temp HP absorbs transferred 2, leaving B 20/20 HP and 0 temp HP. No second resistance, transfer or mitigation occurs. +2 Greater Warding and +1 Warding Bond same-stat AC/save bonuses use strongest +2, not +3.

Caster C pays7 RP and commits Elemental Drain. One element draw is4=lightning and the single3d6 roll is11. Target U is an active creature-classified Undead with current RP7 and no relevant immunity; it fails CON, takes11 ordinary lightning subject to its defenses, then loses min(5,7)=5 RP→2. Target D is a true dead body/corpse, not an active creature: it is not an active RP holder and cannot lose RP; do not infer creature status from the word undead. Target I is an active eligible creature with RP6 and lightning immunity; on failed CON it takes0 lightning but still loses5 RP→1 because damage immunity does not itself cancel the separate resource-loss branch. C gains no RP and no target goes negative.

Beacon is active on fixed support. Enrolled traveler T is an active creature on the same plane, within500 ft, with 2 RP. T spends its Action and commits 2 RP. Under NEW scoped AC4-BEACON-01, immediately before relocation the spell revalidates the same Beacon/support/destination, T eligibility and actual transport blockers. In this fixture an already-sourced environmental collapse event scheduled for that timestamp under the scene's normal event order destroys the marked support before Beacon relocation resolves; Beacon therefore ends and revalidation fails. T stays at origin; Action/RP remain spent; no retry or nearest-square arrival occurs. This checkpoint grants no Reaction or new interrupt window—the collapse was independently scheduled and legal. If no independently legal event changes state, resolution proceeds immediately after commitment/revalidation. Xi still cannot end the Beacon wholesale because it is not an individual ongoing target branch.

Spell Shield applied during caster C's turn after C's regular-start marker records the tenth future C regular-start marker. It is suppressed across markers 4-6, C is absent at marker7 and dies before marker8; suppression/absence/death do not reset or end this nonconcentration ward. It remains unable to trigger while suppressed, resumes if suppression ends, and expires exactly at marker10. Outside initiative the equivalent endpoint is application+60s.

Envoy is Null Disabled0 with 18s left on concentration. A second qualifying Null packet hits the same body: it remains the same Disabled0 identity with no new deadline or reapplication. The caster then voluntarily ends concentration through its actual no-action concentration release; that independent source ending removes the Envoy immediately. Null does not immunize it from concentration expiry/dismissal/replacement.

Envoy at0 is mechanically a living ally only under AC4-SUMMON-TARGET-01. Cleric5 Wisdom16 spends Action+2RP Healing Rite within30ft; S=2, M=3, dice 4+5=9, total12 HP. Envoy rises to12 HP and Null Disabled ends. This targeting classification does not establish soul, natural origin, corpse, biology or loot.
